decision: Tracker adapter contract for epic/story/ticket creation, links, status, close, and credential names
inferred: System.LinkTypes.Hierarchy-Reverse = parent link and System.LinkTypes.Dependency-Reverse = predecessor, from the link-type reference table
Jira transitions = GET/POST /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/transitions with transition.id (standard v3 endpoint, not re-fetched)
question: How do GitHub, Jira Cloud, and Azure DevOps create issues, parent and blocker links, comments, transitions, and authenticate?
unknown: Jira issue type names per project may be renamed; Azure closed state name depends on the process template
verified: Jira Cloud: POST /rest/api/3/issue with fields.project.key, issuetype, summary, description ADF doc, parent.key; POST /rest/api/3/issueLink with type.name + inwardIssue + outwardIssue; POST /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/comment with ADF body; Basic base64(email:api_token)

Azure DevOps: POST {org}/{project}/_apis/wit/workitems/${type}?api-version=7.1 JSON Patch adds /fields/System.Title; PATCH workitems/{id} adds /relations/- {rel,url} (Hyperlink shown) and /fields/System.State; PAT = Basic with empty username
